defensives.name: Shield of Vengeance
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before incoming damage to absorb a large amount and release a burst of damage when it expires, so it doubles as a near free DPS cooldown.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Use to fully immune unavoidable lethal damage or to drop a deadly debuff; cancel it early once the threat passes to minimize the Forbearance lockout on Lay on Hands and Blessing of Protection.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Press before predictable magic or mixed damage events for a 20% damage reduction; its short cooldown means you can use it on most repeating raid hits.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Reserve for an emergency when you or an ally is about to die, fully restoring their health; it triggers Forbearance, so it cannot be chained with Divine Shield or Blessing of Protection.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Cast on yourself or an ally to immune all physical damage during a heavy melee hit; it does not block magic and triggers Forbearance on the target.

defensives.name: Blessing of Spellwarding
defensives.usage_rule: If talented in place of Blessing of Protection, cast to immune a dangerous magical hit on yourself or an ally; it shares Forbearance and does not block physical damage.
